phylogeny.name: Shaded clade boxes, crowded (demo)
phylogeny.description: The twin of the shaded-clade-boxes demo: 150 picornaviruses in 13 genera (a vipr:Genus field), 6 of them a single tip, some side by side, coloured by host (vipr:Host). Opens rectangular with Annotate Clades by Rank at genus as shaded boxes, each named beside its box -- except a box shorter than a line of text, whose name would sit on its neighbours': the 6 one-tip genera carry no name in any window under ~2,000 px tall. The circular and unrooted layouts place the names largest clade first: unrooted moves a name outward where it would touch another, circular leaves it out.
